HOW IT WORKS

“right cool”
BZZT!
CH.1 · WAKE

Say “right cool”

Javis Whisper stays silent until it hears the wake phrase. “right cool” is the only built-in one. You can set your own in Settings.

*poof*
CH.2 · PRIVACY

Memory-only audio

Only the last ~10 s of audio are kept, in memory. They're never saved and are wiped after use.

“Don't tell him that.”
CH.3 · WHISPER

2-3 sentences, then quiet

What to ask next, a sales angle, or a privacy warning. It never asks you questions back. It says its piece and goes quiet.

Remember: Tue follow-up
CH.4 · NOTES

Notes across sessions

Short text-only notes stay on your phone and carry context from one session to the next.

PAIRED!
ZAP!
CH.5 · SETUP

Ready in 4 steps

  1. Install the APK and allow installs from unknown apps.
  2. Set the app's battery usage to Unrestricted.
  3. In Settings, pair with Server URL https://whisper.neuereatec.org and the 6-digit code from the admin page. This loads the xAI key.
  4. Connect your earbuds and press START.
